a2-20-01.title: Communicative Challenge: What We Have Learnt
a2-20-01.scenario: At the language exchange in Hanoi, Meg asks what you have done this year in the course.
a2-20-01.prompt: Tell Meg what you have learnt and shared this year.
cues: Say you have learnt a lot
a2-20-01.target: Hemos aprendido mucho este año. Hemos compartido muchos recuerdos.
a2-20-01.english: We have learnt a lot this year. We have shared many memories.
a2-20-01.canDo: I can talk about experiences and recent actions using the pretérito perfecto.

a2-20-02.title: Communicative Challenge: What Happened
a2-20-02.scenario: Weeks after the goodbye, Carlos asks what happened with Daniela and Lauren.
a2-20-02.prompt: Tell Carlos what Daniela and Lauren did.
cues: Say where Daniela went back to
a2-20-02.target: Daniela regresó a Chile. Lauren encontró un nuevo trabajo.
a2-20-02.english: Daniela returned to Chile. Lauren found a new job.
a2-20-02.canDo: I can recount completed events and simple narratives using the pretérito indefinido.

a2-20-03.title: Communicative Challenge: What Are You Going to Do?
a2-20-03.scenario: At the café, Meg asks what you are going to do after the course.
a2-20-03.prompt: Tell Meg what you are going to do next.
cues: Say you are going to begin a new chapter
Say you are going to return soon
a2-20-03.target: Voy a empezar un nuevo capítulo. Voy a volver pronto.
a2-20-03.english: I am going to begin a new chapter. I am going to return soon.
a2-20-03.canDo: I can talk about immediate future plans using ir a + infinitive.

a2-20-04.title: Communicative Challenge: What Will Happen
a2-20-04.scenario: By the lake in Hanoi, Daniela asks what you think the future will be like.
a2-20-04.prompt: Tell Daniela your prediction and your goal.
cues: Say the future will be different
Say you will achieve your goals
a2-20-04.target: El futuro será diferente. Lograré mis objetivos.
a2-20-04.english: The future will be different. I will achieve my goals.
a2-20-04.canDo: I can talk about predictions, expectations and goals using the futuro simple.

a2-20-05.title: Communicative Challenge: Until Next Time
a2-20-05.scenario: Carlos and Meg walk by the lake in Hanoi. Meg asks you to look back and forward.
a2-20-05.prompt: Tell Meg what you have learnt, what you did and what you will do.
cues: Say what you did by the lake
a2-20-05.target: Hemos aprendido mucho. Caminamos junto al lago. Siempre seremos amigos.
a2-20-05.english: We have learnt a lot. We walked beside the lake. We will always be friends.
a2-20-05.canDo: I can talk about what I have done, what happened and what I will do.

a2-20-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Looking Back, Moving Forward
a2-20-consolidation.scenario: At the language exchange in Hanoi, Lauren asks about your experiences and your plans.
a2-20-consolidation.prompt: Tell Lauren what you have learnt and what you are going to do.
cues: Say what you are going to do
a2-20-consolidation.target: He aprendido mucho. Voy a empezar un nuevo capítulo.
a2-20-consolidation.english: I have learnt a lot. I am going to begin a new chapter.
a2-20-consolidation.canDo: I can use the main A2 structures to talk about experiences, memories and new beginnings.
